file_spec.value: Photo and fingerprints are captured in person by Immigration and Citizenship Service (ICS) staff at the applicant's appointment; the official application guide does not describe any applicant-submitted digital photo file specification.

cross_verification.note_en: Ethiopia's Immigration and Citizenship Service (ics.gov.et) official passport guide requires applicants to attend an in-person appointment where fingerprints and photo are captured by ICS staff on site; the site does not publish applicant-facing photo dimension/background/expression specifications since applicants do not submit their own photo file. Numerous third-party visa-photo vendor sites cite 30×40mm or other figures for Ethiopian passports, but none could be confirmed on an official .gov.et page during this research pass (ics.gov.et and immigration.gov.et carry no dedicated photo-spec document), so all technical composition fields are left unverified rather than sourced to non-official aggregators.
